overview_description.description:
Alana is a jobs marketplace for Hotels, Stores, and Restaurants in LATAM. It is created to match companies with the right talent, and diminish employee turnover and loss of time (+money) in the recruiting process.

Through a web and mobile app, the company match great talent with the right job opportunities in real time. It simplifies communication between companies and candidates through a chatbot and facilitate scheduling through an automatic internal agenda. Also, Alana generate live reports for companies to track their HR process such as time spent in recruiting, turnover rate, current staff satisfaction, among others.
